My name is **Bethany Gifford**. A few fun facts about me are that I love exploring new places, creating meaningful conversations on my podcast, and spending time with my Nashville community and family. I enjoy helping people feel seen, supported, and encouraged in every season of life.

I have been volunteering with **E.L.I.’s House** since **February 2025**. During this time I have helped with mentoring, giving rides when needed, and supporting the moms in both practical and emotional ways. I also served as a **Dean**, which allowed me to walk closely with women who are rebuilding their lives.

I was drawn to volunteer here because my own story has included trauma, abandonment, and addiction. I understand the journey the women are on, and I believe that God never wastes pain when we trust Him with it. Serving at E.L.I.’s House allows me to give back, to sit with women in their stories, and to show them that hope and healing are possible. What I love most about being here is watching God turn pain into purpose and seeing the moms grow stronger each day.
